items.q: Can renewable resources be used up or cause harm?
items.correct: Yes — they replenish but can be depleted (overfishing) or have impacts.
items.misconception: No, renewables never run out and never harm anything.
items.why: Renewable means it can be replenished, not that it is impact-free or limitless if misused.

items.q: Why is water security an issue if Earth is mostly water?
items.correct: Most water is salty or frozen; usable fresh water is scarce and unevenly spread.
items.misconception: There is no shortage of usable water anywhere.
items.random_wrong: All water on Earth is drinkable.
items.why: Only a small fraction is accessible fresh water, and it isn't where all the people are.
